title: Visual facets
description: The payloads of the simple facets of the bundled visual plugin: how a node, an edge or a canvas is drawn. Facets whose payload the dialect cannot yet state stay hand-written beside this contract.

NamespacedId.description: The id of a registered theme, stencil or icon: a plugin id and a name.
NamespacedId.x-wb-message: must be a namespaced id like "visual.diamond"

FacetKey.description: A facet key as ADR-0013 decision 2 grammars it: namespace, name and version.
FacetKey.x-wb-message: must be a facet key like "visual.shape/v0"

EdgeRoutingStyle.description: How an edge gets from one endpoint to the other once the router must step around something; the model vocabulary, spelled the same.

LineJumps.description: Whether a small arc is drawn where one edge crosses another; the model vocabulary, spelled the same.

VisualShapeKind.description: A silhouette a node may draw. The historic rect is the absent facet and has no value here.

VisualShapeFacet.description: visual.shape/v0: what silhouette this node draws.

VisualSymbolIcon.description: A symbol drawn from the registered icon set, by name.

VisualSymbolEmoji.description: A symbol that is one emoji or character.

char.description: The character: one extended grapheme cluster, so a flag or a family is one.

VisualSymbolFacet.description: visual.symbol/v0: what symbolises this object, as an icon or one emoji.
VisualSymbolFacet.x-wb-describe: What SYMBOLISES this object, for surfaces too small to read it: the minimap, a row in the document browser, the tab favicon. NOT drawn on a canvas — a node at full size already shows its own content — so a badge written to say what a box IS or how it is DOING is invisible to anyone reading the board. To record state or kind on a board, write a scoped tag instead (`priority:high`) AND declare its key in the workspace tag library: a declared value carries a colour, so the boxes wearing it are drawn in it and the board legend names it. A tag nobody declared is recorded and drawn in nothing.

VisualTextAlign.description: Where the text of a node sits inside the space it has.

VisualTextFacet.description: visual.text/v0: where the text of a node sits; absent means its default.

VisualEdgesFacet.description: visual.edges/v0: how edges are drawn, on a canvas or on one edge.

routing.description: How an edge steps around an obstacle.

lineJumps.description: Whether crossings are drawn with an arc.

VisualInkFacet.description: visual.ink/v0: which strokes are one thing, as the id of the group a line belongs to.

group.description: The group id; lines sharing it are one object.

VisualStrokeWidth.description: A stored stroke weight. Thin is the historic weight of every line and is the absent facet.

VisualStrokeFacet.description: visual.stroke/v0: how heavy a stroke is drawn.

VisualThemeFacet.description: visual.theme/v0: how a canvas is drawn, as the id of a registered theme asset.

VisualStencilFacet.description: visual.stencil/v0: which registered stencil a node wears, by id.

VisualAxes.description: The facet keys a canvas treats as semantic axes, at most 64.
VisualAxes.x-wb-maxItemsMessage: more axes than the 64-axis limit for one board

VisualAxesFacet.description: visual.axes/v0: which of its own facets a canvas treats as semantic axes.
